output:
To: #jobs
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Desert Palms codes and equipment

Marco, I'm pissed. You told me Saturday Desert Palms was done, 14 units all good, keys dropped with Yvette. Not one code is in the sheet. That job was not done.

Lupe told me this morning the tenant in 9B lost her key and Yvette needs three copies today. We should be able to look up the code and cut them. Instead we have nothing to cut from and somebody has to go back out there. Yvette also says there's a black pinning tray with pins sitting on the leasing office counter. That's my tray. Bring it back.

I put this out to everybody August 4. Every rekey, every master job, address, unit and bitting code in the sheet SAME DAY, before you leave the van. Not when somebody calls needing a key. Not when you get around to it. Same day. That wasn't a suggestion.

We already had this conversation on the Kessler job in September. I told you then to get the missing codes in. I should not have to keep chasing you for the same part of the job.

You're going back to Desert Palms today. Arrange access with Yvette and decode 9B first so we can get those three keys cut today. Decode all 14 units if you can get access. Put the codes in the sheet today. If you can't get into every unit, tell me exactly which ones are still missing and what the plan is to finish them. Don't leave me guessing.

Get the tray and check that the pins and everything with it come back. Let me know when 9B is logged and when the tray is back.

You do good work with your hands. I'm not firing you. But keeping the records and bringing our equipment home are part of the work too. This cannot keep happening.
